name: What is the cost range for custom banquette seating construction?
description: Cost varies based on size, design complexity, and materials, from basic linear foot pricing to higher costs for custom features.

mainEntity.name: What is the cost range for custom banquette seating construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of custom banquette seating varies widely depending on size, design complexity, material choices (frame, upholstery, cushioning), and any integrated features like storage. Basic designs might start from a few hundred dollars per linear foot, while complex, high-end installations can be significantly more. To get an accurate estimate, it's beneficial to have a clear idea of your desired specifications and materials before requesting a quote, as these factors most heavily influence the final price.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost varies based on size, design complexity, and materials, from basic linear foot pricing to higher costs for custom features.
